name: pr-submission
description: Use whenever the user asks to submit, open, create, or publish a pull request (PR) — e.g. "submit this as PR", "open a PR", "create PR for me", "submit PR", "make a PR". Enforces pre-submission package validation, active branch reuse (only branching when on main, master, or detached HEAD), strict zero-AI-attribution commit standards, and mandatory full adherence to .github/pull_request_template.md without removing any sections or checkboxes.
